high_level_description: The image is a vibrant nighttime scene featuring the Vegas Sphere, a large illuminated spherical structure located in Las Vegas, Nevada. The sphere is adorned with an intricate display of lights that form the design of the American flag. The stars are white and arranged in a pattern reminiscent of the U.S. flag, while the stripes are composed of blue and white lights, with red lights at the bottom to represent the red stripe. The text overlay on the image reads: "Did you know? NVIDIA Powers the Vegas Sphere With 150 RTX A6000 GPUs (7.2TB GDDR6 Memory) and 1.
